After rolling and subsequent air cooling, the intermetallic alloy contains the O phase (gray) and the β(B2) phase (bright)
the β(B2) phase in the intermetallic alloy is enriched in β stabilizers, namely, niobium and vanadium, whereas the contents of these elements in the O phase are significantly lower
The VT25U titanium alloy is a two-phase alloy and consists of titanium-based α and β solid solutions with the hcp and bcc lattices
the VT25U alloy contains the β component of the microstructure (gray) and α-phase grains (dark)
